decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9771. Series context: trend strength 0.9591 and seasonal strength 0.2553; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.166); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.526.
